article.sacredRoles.four-royals.p.the-dr: The Dragon and Phoenix reign over the realm of ideas and ethereal thought structures — templates, proclamations, standards, and the architecture of how things ought to be held in mind before they are lived in the body. The Dragon guards power and the templates of excellence; the Phoenix proclaims security through beauty, display, and the visible promise that all is well.
article.sacredRoles.four-royals.p.the-ti: The Tiger and Bear reign over the realm of instincts and juicy, sensuous experience — conviction felt in the chest, abundance tasted at the table, ideals embodied in motion, and harmony curated in the flesh of daily life. The Tiger radiates inspiration as living proof; the Bear, as Royal of Harmony, is guardian and protector of peace, holding the atmosphere others settle into through generosity, refuge, and unhurried authority.
article.sacredRoles.four-royals.li.the-d: The Dragon — Royal of Power & Prestige (Celestial King)
article.sacredRoles.four-royals.li.the-p: The Phoenix — Royal of Stability & Security (Celestial Queen)
article.sacredRoles.four-royals.li.the-t: The Tiger — Royal of Inspiration & Idealism (Earthly King)
article.sacredRoles.four-royals.li.the-b: The Bear — Royal of Peace & Harmony (Earthly Queen)
article.sacredRoles.four-royals.p.each-r: Each Royal embodies its Core Value at the center of its being. Read how all twelve animals live their Sacred Roles on the Values Triangles page.
article.sacredRoles.p.read-how-each-tote: Read how each totem animal lives Power, Stability, Inspiration, and Harmony — as Seeker, Mage, or Royal.

page.services.business-goals.p.align-you: Align your work and ambitions with your totem strengths — timing, partnerships, and decisions that fit who you were born to be and where you're headed.
page.services.new-connections.p.entering: Entering a new chapter? Find the people and opportunities that match your guides — friendships, community, and fresh starts worth pursuing.
